targetType.description: Target type name.  Present in reports when grouped by targetTypeId

errorCode.description: Error code.  Only valid for error reporting.

lastError.description: Timestamp of latest error for the group.  Only present in error reports

review.description: If errors reviewed, the id of the review for the group and null otherwise.  Only present in error reports

count.description: Number of entries in the group.

title:
Results returned from {@link InvalidationQueueStore.count} or various queue report functions.  Any field that is
grouped in a request will be present in the results.  Those that are not will be null.
name: InvalidationQueueGroupResult
